_comment: Attribution list (PLAN.md R5). Data entries: attribution_text is the exact text the licence requires, from geo2map_engine docs/pipeline/README.md (section 5 table) and geo2map_data/SOURCES.md; the ASCII (c) of those files is written as the copyright sign. geo2map_datasets lists the exact 'Dataset' cells of that table an entry covers; tests/unit/test_credits.cpp fails when a table row is missing here. in_game=false: downloaded for a planned feature, shown in its own section.
